title: Machine Learning Aided Computational Discovery of Boride Substrates for Borophene Synthesis
summary: DFT and machine-learning screening covered 1,356 surfaces, identifying candidate boride substrates for two borophene phases. Most candidates were model-predicted; synthesis was not demonstrated.
organization: Affiliation not stated in the reviewed material

evidence.tested: DFT and machine-learning screening covered 1,356 surfaces, identifying candidate boride substrates for two borophene phases. Most candidates were model-predicted; synthesis was not demonstrated.
evidence.unknown: Candidate substrate performance and synthesis remain experimentally untested.
